title: Transfer must check identityRegistry.isVerified
desc: In `transfer` or `transferFrom`, the token must call `identityRegistry.isVerified` to ensure the recipient is eligible.
policyRef: EIP-3643 specification — Token interface / transfer conditions (EIP doc) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643

title: Token must call compliance.canTransfer hook
desc: Before executing transfers, token should invoke `compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount)` to enforce additional compliance rules.
snippet: if (compliance != address(0)) require(compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount), "ERC-3643: compliance failed");
policyRef: EIP-3643 spec — canTransfer in Token interface (EIP-3643) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643

title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
desc: Claim Topics Registry must expose `addClaimTopic`, `removeClaimTopic`, `getClaimTopics`, and emit `ClaimTopicAdded`/`ClaimTopicRemoved` events.
snippet: function addClaimTopic(uint256 _claimTopic); event ClaimTopicAdded(uint256 indexed claimTopic); function getClaimTopics() external view returns (uint256[] memory);
policyRef: ERC-3643 docs — Claim Topics Registry interface and events https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/claim-topics-registry/ https://docs.erc3643.org

title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
desc: Identity Registry should allow updating the associated ClaimTopicsRegistry via `setClaimTopicsRegistry(address)`.
policyRef: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter methods https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/identity-registry/ https://docs.erc3643.org

title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
desc: Identity Registry must allow updating the Trusted Issuers Registry via `setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)`.
policyRef: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter for trusted issuers https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/identity-registry/

title: Identity Registry must expose isVerified view function
desc: Identity Registry should have `isVerified(address)` to allow checking eligibility off-chain or from token.
snippet: function isVerified(address userAddress) external view returns (bool);
policyRef: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — isVerified definition https://erc-3643.github.io/documentation/docs/suite/identity-registry/

title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
desc: Token should emit `IdentityRegistryAdded(address)` and `ComplianceAdded(address)` events when wiring these contracts.
snippet: event IdentityRegistryAdded(address indexed); event ComplianceAdded(address indexed);
policyRef: EIP-3643 specification — Token interface events list https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643

title: Token must support freezing / unfreezing of address
desc: Token should implement `setAddressFrozen(address, bool)` or similar to control freezing of accounts.
policyRef: EIP-3643 standard mentions freeze/unfreeze in Token interface / events section https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643

title: Token must be compatible with ERC-20 interface
desc: ERC-3643 tokens must implement standard ERC-20 functions: `transfer`, `approve`, `allowance`, etc.
snippet: function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool); function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

title: Token must support recovery functionality
desc: Token should implement recovery mechanism in case an investor loses keys, e.g., `recover(address lost, address new)`.
policyRef: EIP-3643 specification — recovery function discussion in Token interface https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3643
